sentences.l2: 大学宿舍是许多年轻人第一次经历集体生活的场所。
sentences.l1: The university dormitory is where many young people experience collective living for the first time.

sentences.l2: 来自不同地域、习惯各异的室友被安排在同一屋檐下，朝夕相处。
sentences.l1: Roommates from different regions and with different habits are assigned under the same roof, living together day and night.

sentences.l2: 然而，正是这种近距离的接触，往往在无形中埋下矛盾的种子。
sentences.l1: However, it is precisely this close contact that often plants the seeds of conflict without anyone noticing.

sentences.l2: 作息时间上的差异尤为突出：有人习惯挑灯夜读，有人则清晨便起身忙碌。
sentences.l1: Differences in daily schedules are especially prominent: some people are used to studying late into the night by lamplight, while others get up and get busy at dawn.

sentences.l2: 当一方需要安静入睡，另一方却仍在敲击键盘时，摩擦便悄然滋生。
sentences.l1: When one person needs quiet to fall asleep while the other is still tapping on a keyboard, friction quietly arises.

sentences.l2: 此外，卫生分工不均、物品随意借用等琐事，也可能成为积怨的导火索。
sentences.l1: In addition, trivial matters such as uneven division of cleaning and casually borrowing belongings may also become the fuse of accumulated resentment.

sentences.l2: 值得注意的是，这些矛盾并非不可调和。
sentences.l1: It is worth noting that these conflicts are not irreconcilable.

sentences.l2: 真正决定宿舍氛围的，是室友之间是否愿意彼此体谅、坦诚沟通。
sentences.l1: What truly determines the atmosphere of a dormitory is whether roommates are willing to be considerate of each other and communicate frankly.

sentences.l2: 若人人都固守自己的边界，拒绝换位思考，再微小的分歧也会演变为难以逾越的鸿沟；反之，只要大家愿意制定共同的规则，尊重彼此的生活节奏，集体生活便能从磨合走向和谐。
sentences.l1: If everyone stubbornly holds to their own boundaries and refuses to put themselves in others' shoes, even the smallest disagreement will turn into an impassable chasm; conversely, as long as everyone is willing to set common rules and respect each other's pace of life, collective living can move from adjustment to harmony.
